adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new logic iterates `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` and, when it can’t find the matching credential in `this.calendarCredentials`, it now fetches it directly from the DB via `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: destination.credentialId } })` and then proceeds to call `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)`. The diff shows no validation that the fetched credential belongs to the organizer/any host for this booking (e.g., matching `userId`/`teamId` against the booking context), and no check to skip credentials marked `invalid` (it copies `invalid` into the constructed object but still uses it). Previously, if the credential wasn’t present in `this.calendarCredentials`, it would not create an event for that destination at all (i.e., effectively skipped). This is a real behavior change that can cause events/attendee data/notes to be written using a credential that isn’t part of the active host credentials set.
